title: Finite presentation relative to a base is checkable after pushforward along a finite morphism
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For pi : X -> Y a finite morphism of schemes locally of finite type over S and F a quasi-coherent O_X-module, F is of finite presentation relative to S if and only if pi_*F is of finite presentation relative to S. The retained proof is the author's own word: 'translation of the result of More on Algebra, lemma finite-extension into the language of schemes' — the ring-theoretic equivalence for finite ring extensions B over A and B-modules versus their restrictions as A-modules, quoted by name; no scheme-side argument beyond the standard affine translation is added. Retained author proof at lines 16481-16485.
